name: SCAD AI IDE managed OpenSCAD capabilities
description: Use when managing OpenSCAD runtimes, library dependencies, Customizer parameters or SCAD AI IDE diagnostics.

name: openscad-customizer
description: Author, inspect, repair and validate OpenSCAD Customizer source declarations rather than runtime parameter overrides.

name: openscad-runtime
description: Detect, install, select or repair the selected OpenSCAD CLI runtime in SCAD AI IDE, including offline archives and extension-host executable paths.

name: openscad-libraries
description: Search, install exact OpenSCAD library versions, restore project dependencies, verify or repair global sources, or safely clean library storage through SCAD AI IDE.

name: openscad-customizer
description: Inspect and change OpenSCAD model Customizer parameters or manage named JSON presets with SCAD AI IDE while preserving target identity and Preview behavior.

name: openscad-customizer-authoring
description: Create, migrate, inspect, repair and objectively validate OpenSCAD Customizer source with bounded source tools, preserving model geometry and unsaved buffers.

name: scad-ai-ide-diagnostics
description: Diagnose SCAD AI IDE runtime, library and GitHub status, or inspect bounded redacted disposable caches only when the extension runs in Development mode.

name: openscad-model-debugging
description: Diagnose and repair OpenSCAD compiler, assert, missing-library and unknown-symbol problems using current Problems and snapshot-bound official CLI evidence. Does not prove mesh validity, assembly clearance or printability.
